facts: Mobileye's current Investor Relations events page lists Evercore's 9th Annual ADAS, AV & AI Forum for September 29, 2026 at 9:40 AM EDT.
The current page therefore resolves the exact timing that Mobileye's July 30 conference announcement had said would be posted closer to the event.
The event remains an information-update window; the issuer page does not promise a product, financial or commercial announcement.

factors.name: catalystScore
factors.basis: The previously identified September 29 ADAS/AV/AI forum now has a current issuer-posted exact time, tightening the monitoring window without implying that material news will be released.

factors.name: executionMonitoring
factors.basis: Council Alpha can now anchor a precise post-event evidence refresh to September 29 at 9:40 AM EDT and test any management commentary against existing ADAS, robotaxi, pipeline and physical-AI execution claims.

risks.risk: An exact event time increases monitoring precision but does not convert conference participation into operating evidence or guarantee new disclosure.

contradictions: The July 30 issuer announcement left exact timing open; the current issuer events page now supplies 9:40 AM EDT, reducing scheduling uncertainty but not business-outcome uncertainty.
unknowns: Whether the September 29 session will be webcast or archived.
Whether management will provide materially new financial, commercial or technical information.
Whether any new disclosure will change a Methodology 1.0 underwriting factor rather than merely reiterate existing strategy.
